exposure: patient characteristics (gestation weeks, previous deliveries, history of mental illness, ethnicity, parity)
cohort: Pregnant women who received obstetric care in a university-affiliated hospital in Hong Kong during an early stage of the COVID-19 pandemic.
finding: Pregnant women adapted to the early COVID-19 pandemic by adjusting obstetric service attendance, working from home, and mask-wearing, but often had expectations that did not match changes in childbirth companionship and peripartum services.
